name: Ngx Prime Default
tagline: SSR-ready Angular 22 landing starter with Tailwind and signal-based theming
description: A prerender-first Angular 22 starter built for fast marketing and business landing pages. Ships with SSR/prerender wired up, Tailwind CSS, light/dark theming on CSS variables, and a bootstrap layer for company data and multilingual content.

Tailwind CSS with a shared design-token theme (light and dark)
Company bootstrap layer backed by signals
Built-in multilingual switching
SEO metadata wired through route data
